comment: Quest chains in Fernkeep. Each citizen has a storyline. Quests unlock buildings, recipes, and city events.

intro_first_citizen.name: A Familiar Face
intro_first_citizen.description: A wanderer has arrived at your hamlet. They need a place to stay.

objectives.description: Build a house for the new arrival.

dialogue.start: Well, look at this place. Could use some work, but it's got potential. You wouldn't happen to have a spare room, would you?
dialogue.complete: That'll do nicely! I'll get settled in. Maybe others will follow once word gets around.

intro_first_income.name: Earn Your Keep
intro_first_income.description: Your first citizen is settled. Time to start generating some income.

dialogue.start: A town needs income to grow. Let the gold flow in and see what happens.
dialogue.complete: Now you're talking. With gold in the treasury, we can start building something real.

intro_build_tavern.name: The First Round
intro_build_tavern.description: Every good settlement needs a gathering place.

objectives.description: Assign a citizen as tavern staff.

dialogue.start: People need a place to eat, drink, and hear the news. Build a tavern and it'll pay for itself.
dialogue.complete: Ahh, now that smells like a real town. I'll be a regular, I promise.

intro_first_quest_board.name: Word Gets Around
intro_first_quest_board.description: Citizens are starting to talk. Post a notice to attract more arrivals.

dialogue.start: Five people. That's not a hamlet anymore — that's a village in the making.
dialogue.complete: Look at that. People are coming. Let's make sure they want to stay.

npc_chain_aldric_1.name: The Wandering Cook
npc_chain_aldric_1.description: A cook has arrived claiming they can change the whole reputation of your tavern — if you give them a proper kitchen.

dialogue.start: You've got good ingredients in this land. But that kitchen? I've seen better setups in a cave. Upgrade it and I'll make you something worth talking about.
dialogue.complete: Much better. Now stand back and let me work.

npc_chain_aldric_2.name: A Recipe Worth Keeping
npc_chain_aldric_2.description: The cook needs wild honey from the forest for a special dish.

dialogue.start: There's wild honey out there in that forest. Bring me five jars and I'll make a dish this town will never forget.
dialogue.complete: Perfect. Golden, fragrant, exactly right. Watch what happens to your tavern's reputation after tonight.

npc_chain_aldric_3.name: The Feast of Fernkeep
npc_chain_aldric_3.description: The cook wants to host a feast for the whole city. It'll cost you, but the reputation gain will be enormous.

objectives.description: Maintain 70%+ city happiness during the feast.

dialogue.start: I want to cook for everyone. One great feast — the kind that people talk about for years. It'll cost, but Fernkeep will never be the same after.
dialogue.complete: Did you see their faces? This city has a reputation now. I'm staying as long as you'll have me.

npc_chain_enchanter_1.name: The Arriving Enchanter
npc_chain_enchanter_1.description: A rare enchanter has arrived. They'll settle here — but only if you have a magic tower.

dialogue.start: I can feel the ley lines here. Strong ones. But I need a proper place to work. Build me a tower and I'll make this city hum with magic.
dialogue.complete: Yes. This will do. I can already feel the threads of power settling into place.

npc_chain_enchanter_2.name: A Citizen's Charm
npc_chain_enchanter_2.description: The enchanter wants to brew a Citizen's Charm — a potion that draws better people to the city.

dialogue.start: The ingredients are seasonal — you'll need to act while spring lasts. Rare flowers and enchanted berries. Get me those and I'll brew something that changes who comes to Fernkeep.
dialogue.complete: There. A Citizen's Charm. Use it wisely — its effects won't last forever, but the citizens it draws will.

npc_chain_blacksmith_1.name: The Smith's Arrival
npc_chain_blacksmith_1.description: A rare blacksmith has arrived in town. Their skill alone will unlock a building no one else can build.

dialogue.start: I've heard there's room in this city for a smith. Give me a place to live and I'll show you what proper craftsmanship looks like.
dialogue.complete: Right. Now — are you going to build me a forge, or shall I just make do with a fire pit?

npc_chain_blacksmith_2.name: First Fire
npc_chain_blacksmith_2.description: The blacksmith is ready to work. Build their forge.

dialogue.start: Stone, ore, and a proper bellows. That's all I need. Give me those and I'll make tools that last a lifetime.
dialogue.complete: First fire's lit. First blade's already cooling. You'll notice the difference in your building costs — good tools make good builders.

seasonal_spring_bloom.name: The Bloom Festival
seasonal_spring_bloom.description: Spring has arrived. Citizens want floral decorations and light herb dishes. A happy city earns bonus gold during the festival.

objectives.description: Serve 10 Bloom Festival Teas at the tavern.
Maintain 75%+ city happiness through the festival.

seasonal_summer_harvest.name: The Harvest Rush
seasonal_summer_harvest.description: Summer brings a rush of merchants and doubled farm output. Make the most of it.

objectives.description: Produce 30 farm ingredients during the summer.

harvest_festival_quest.name: The Grand Harvest Feast
harvest_festival_quest.description: The summer fair calls for a grand feast. Prepare the Seasonal Harvest Feast for the whole city.

seasonal_autumn_wanderer.name: The Wanderer's Moon
seasonal_autumn_wanderer.description: Autumn brings mysterious travellers with rare quests and enchanted ingredients.

seasonal_winter_frost.name: The Frost Quiet
seasonal_winter_frost.description: Winter is hard. Passive income slows and citizens need warmth and food. Keep happiness up to survive the Frost Quiet.

objectives.description: Keep city happiness above 65% through the winter.

winter_festival.name: The Winter Festival
winter_festival.description: You've survived the frost. Throw the Winter Festival — the biggest reputation event of the year.

objectives.description: Achieve 80%+ city happiness during the festival.

dialogue.start: The frost is broken. It's time for Fernkeep's greatest celebration.
dialogue.complete: They'll talk about this festival for years. Fernkeep's reputation is known across the land.

market_first_caravan.name: Strange Visitors
market_first_caravan.description: A caravan has arrived at the market. Their wares are unusual — and their prices, negotiable.

objectives.description: Complete a barter deal with the caravan.

market_trade_route.name: The Long Road
market_trade_route.description: A merchant wants to establish a regular trade route with Fernkeep. Prove the city can handle the volume.

dialogue.start: Your market has potential. Show me it can handle real volume, and I'll set up a permanent route.
dialogue.complete: Done. You'll see my wagons here regularly now. Fernkeep is officially on the trade map.

guild_first_expedition.name: Into the Unknown
guild_first_expedition.description: The guild has dispatched its first expedition. Wait for them to return.

objectives.description: Dispatch an expedition from the guild hall.
Wait 3 in-game days for the expedition to return.

quest_types.arrival: Triggered when a new citizen arrives.
quest_types.build: Triggered by building or upgrading structures.
quest_types.npc_story: Personal storyline for a specific NPC archetype.
quest_types.gathering: Collect specific ingredients through foraging, fishing, or farming.
quest_types.crafting: Craft a specific potion or item at the magic tower.
quest_types.cooking_challenge: Cook a specific dish at the tavern.
quest_types.seasonal_event: Triggered at the start of a season, expires at season end.
quest_types.city_event: Triggered by player action — a feast, festival, or ceremony.
quest_types.trade: Related to the market and caravan system.
quest_types.expedition: Sent out by the guild hall.
quest_types.progression: Tied to city stat milestones like citizen count or reputation.
